entries.root_cause: Blocking only direct frame and namespace attribute names in the ledger-credited outer probes was insufficient because Python dunder reflection could recover the same global namespaces indirectly through function __globals__, module __dict__, and __getattribute__, then reach sys._getframe and the imported delegated receiver without using the previously forbidden literal access path.

The isolated-child helper integrity check authenticated that one correct subprocess.run call existed in the helper AST but did not prove that control flow reached it. An unconditional early return could therefore preserve the expected subprocess syntax while skipping the isolated permissive-rejection proof entirely.
